about: What the oldest released Meno still in use (tools/released.txt) reads in a catalogue's entry: catalogue.json holds only the entries it reads whole; catalogue-2.json holds every entry, for Meno 0.1.23 and later. Taken from that Meno's own code (lib/plugins/roles ROLES, lib/plugins/manifest SYSTEMS, lib/plugins/catalogue KIND); tools/released.test.ts holds catalogue.json to its real reading.
